Trim, key, caption.

01 · Trim

Every pause, found and cut

AI agents mark the dead air, the false starts and the “um, so”. You see each cut on a timeline and keep the ones you want back before the final render.

The green screen goes. Pick a built in studio or upload any image.

Your AI agent can drive it too

The limits

Simple limits. Free while we're in beta.

10minLongest take you can upload
2GBBiggest file, MP4 or MOV
1080pHighest resolution in and out
30daysWe keep your videos, then delete them

Questions

Before you upload. The short answers.

One take on your phone or camera. Film in front of a green screen if you want a studio background. Without one, you still get the pauses trimmed and a transcript.

MP4 or MOV, up to 10 minutes long, about 2 GB, and up to 1080p. If a file is over a limit, we tell you which one before anything uploads.

Yes. After the automatic trim you get a review timeline. Tap any cut to keep it, then render the final video.

English for now. Captions download as SRT, timed to the trimmed video, and as plain text.

The original and the finished video are kept for 30 days and then deleted automatically. Transcripts stay until you delete the take. Deleting a take removes everything.

Nothing while we're in beta. Each account has a monthly processing limit. Paid plans come later, and we'll tell you before anything changes.

Soon. A public API and an MCP server will let agents do everything the web app does: upload, review cuts, pick a studio and fetch captions.
